quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in such position as to block the driveway or entrance to any abutting property.

activation.condition: A person stops, stands or parks a vehicle within a legally qualifying alley.

obligation.description: Must not place that vehicle so as to block the driveway or entrance to abutting property.

timing.description: Original stopping, standing and parking episode while the vehicle is positioned in the alley.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: block the driveway or entrance to any abutting property
judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric statutory blocking cutoff; original footprint, access geometry and permitted vehicular use require review.

parameter_refs.name: access_kind
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: driveway or entrance to abutting property

parameter_refs.name: parking_position
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: clear or overlapping source-surveyed access corridor; no legal label
